arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT e.Diagnosis) FROM main.Examination AS e WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR e.Diagnosis LIKE '%lupus%') AS diagnoses,
    (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT p.SEX) FROM main.Patient AS p) AS sex_codes,
    group_concat(DISTINCT typeof(l.TP)) AS tp_types,
    group_concat(DISTINCT l.TP) AS high_tp_values
FROM main.Laboratory AS l
WHERE l.TP > 8.5;

WITH decimal_input AS (
    SELECT 1 AS group_id, CAST(ROUND(l.TP * 10) AS INTEGER) - 85 AS scaled_value
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5
  AND l.ID IN (
      SELECT e.ID
      FROM main.Examination AS e
      WHERE instr(
          ',' || replace(replace(replace(e.Diagnosis, ' ', ''), '+', ','), '->', ',') || ',',
          ',SLE,'
      ) > 0
  )
), decimal_bounds AS (
  SELECT group_id, scaled_value,
    COUNT(scaled_value) OVER g AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scaled_value IS NOT NULL AND typeof(scaled_value) <> 'integer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS invalid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value NOT BETWEEN -9007199254740 AND 9007199254740 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS oversized_count,
    TOTAL(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value BETWEEN -9007199254740 AND 9007199254740 THEN ABS(scaled_value) ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS abs_total
  FROM decimal_input
  WINDOW g AS (PARTITION BY group_id)
), decimal_totals AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count,
    CASE WHEN invalid_count > 0 THEN 'invalid_input'
      WHEN n = 0 THEN 'empty'
      WHEN oversized_count > 0 OR abs_total > 9007199254740
        OR n > 900719925474099 THEN 'overflow'
      ELSE 'ok' END AS status,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invalid_count = 0 AND oversized_count = 0
      AND abs_total <= 9007199254740 AND n <= 900719925474099
      THEN scaled_value END) AS scaled_sum
  FROM decimal_bounds
  GROUP BY group_id
), decimal_fraction AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    scaled_sum * 1000 AS numerator, n * 10 AS denominator
  FROM decimal_totals
), decimal_rounded AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN numerator / denominator
      + CASE WHEN ABS(numerator % denominator) >= (denominator + 1) / 2
        THEN CASE WHEN numerator < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END END AS rounded_units
  FROM decimal_fraction
), decimal_result AS (
  SELECT *, rounded_units * 1.0 / 1000 AS rounded_value
  FROM decimal_rounded
)
SELECT n, status, invalid_count, rounded_value FROM decimal_result;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS average_tp_deviation
FROM main.Laboratory AS l
JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5
  AND l.ID IN (
      SELECT e.ID
      FROM main.Examination AS e
      WHERE instr(
          ',' || replace(replace(replace(e.Diagnosis, ' ', ''), '+', ','), '->', ',') || ',',
          ',SLE,'
      ) > 0
  )
LIMIT 1;
